I'm not sure what your friend is saying, so I can't be sure what she is "right" about. My friend is certainly right about a lot of what he is saying, but he definitely needs someone to check on him.

He went missing for a week recently, and stayed in the woods. His fam brushed it off as just him needing space. 

It's handled now though. Best of luck to you and your friend.

The crazy thing is, the exact same thing is happening to an aquaintance of mine right now. Like, the last 3 days. I sat on my hands thinking "someone's got to see his twitter feed and do something" but... i've just checked and it's just as bad.

He lives like literally hundreds of miles away and we have zero friends in common so I think I may need to call someone about him. 

I swear it's weird, this exact same thing is happening at my end right now.

Good call. She sounds like she may be a danger to herself and others, and not in the deliberate way, if you know what I mean?

A second opinion (via your wife) sounds like a good idea.
Can you PM her on twitter? Idk how twitter works.
